purpose: Original cutout body-part registration for hand-painted Hua Xia workers, water carriers and merchants.
camera: orthographic dimetric; 0 NW back, 1 mirrored NE back, 2 mirrored SW front, 3 SE front

poses.walking_phase: near phase t, far phase t + pi; foot contact travel cos(t), swing lift max(0,sin(t)); arms counter-swing
poses.load: 38px hip squat, 0.65rad forward torso bend, constrained 102px hand reach
poses.hammer: prepare, raised, overhead, descent, strike, contact, recoil, recover
poses.climb: opposed hands/feet move through alternating rungs
poses.cycle_selection: movement uses route distance; stationary work uses elapsed action time

processing: Alpha connected-component extraction, source joint-cap crop, limb affine transforms and compositing only. No painted or synthetic replacement pixels.
source_attribution: Original generated supplementary human art. People in the user reference city screenshot are too small to extract identifiable source poses.
